files_one_inspection_photo.name: files_one_inspection_photo
files_one_inspection_photo.where: "files"."inspection_photo_name" is not null and "files"."confirmed_at" is not null and "files"."deleted_at" is null

files_one_damage_photo.name: files_one_damage_photo
files_one_damage_photo.where: "files"."damage_mark_id" is not null and "files"."confirmed_at" is not null and "files"."deleted_at" is null

files_one_link_photo_per_side.name: files_one_link_photo_per_side
files_one_link_photo_per_side.where: "files"."renter_link_id" is not null and "files"."submission_id" is null and "files"."confirmed_at" is not null and "files"."deleted_at" is null

files_one_licence_scan_per_side.name: files_one_licence_scan_per_side
files_one_licence_scan_per_side.where: "files"."renter_id" is not null and "files"."confirmed_at" is not null and "files"."deleted_at" is null

files_one_logo_per_operator.name: files_one_logo_per_operator
files_one_logo_per_operator.where: "files"."purpose" = 'operator_logo' and "files"."confirmed_at" is not null and "files"."deleted_at" is null

files_damage_record_photos.name: files_damage_record_photos
files_damage_record_photos.value: "files"."damage_record_id" is null or ("files"."purpose"::text in ('vehicle_photo', 'vehicle_photo_thumbnail') and "files"."inspection_id" is null)

files_inspection_photos.name: files_inspection_photos
files_inspection_photos.value:
("files"."inspection_id" is null or "files"."purpose"::text = 'vehicle_photo')
        and ("files"."inspection_photo_name" is null or "files"."inspection_id" is not null)
        and ("files"."damage_mark_id" is null or "files"."inspection_id" is not null)
        and ("files"."inspection_photo_name" is null or "files"."damage_mark_id" is null)

files_vehicle_purposes.name: files_vehicle_purposes
files_vehicle_purposes.value:
("files"."purpose"::text not in ('vehicle_photo', 'vehicle_photo_thumbnail', 'vehicle_document') or "files"."vehicle_id" is not null)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text <> 'operator_logo' or "files"."vehicle_id" is null)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text = 'vehicle_photo_thumbnail') = ("files"."thumbnail_of_file_id" is not null)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text in ('vehicle_photo', 'vehicle_document', 'vehicle_attachment', 'vehicle_identity_attachment')) = ("files"."label" is not null)

files_attachment_links.name: files_attachment_links
files_attachment_links.value:
num_nonnulls("files"."registration_id", "files"."policy_id", "files"."cost_id", "files"."purchase_id", "files"."sale_id")
          = (case when "files"."purpose"::text in ('vehicle_attachment', 'vehicle_identity_attachment') then 1 else 0 end)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text <> 'vehicle_identity_attachment' or num_nonnulls("files"."purchase_id", "files"."sale_id") = 1)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text <> 'vehicle_attachment' or num_nonnulls("files"."purchase_id", "files"."sale_id") = 0)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text not in ('vehicle_attachment', 'vehicle_identity_attachment') or ("files"."policy_id" is null) = ("files"."vehicle_id" is not null))

files_licence_scan_links.name: files_licence_scan_links
files_licence_scan_links.value:
("files"."purpose"::text = 'renter_licence_scan') = ("files"."renter_id" is not null)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text <> 'renter_submitted_scan' or ("files"."renter_link_id" is not null and "files"."renter_id" is null))
        and ("files"."purpose"::text in ('renter_licence_scan', 'renter_submitted_scan')) = ("files"."licence_side" is not null)
        and ("files"."renter_link_id" is null or "files"."purpose"::text in ('renter_licence_scan', 'renter_submitted_scan'))
        and ("files"."submission_id" is null or "files"."renter_link_id" is not null)
        and ("files"."licence_side" is null or "files"."vehicle_id" is null)

renter_links_signing_details.name: renter_links_signing_details
renter_links_signing_details.value:
("renter_links"."purpose"::text in ('sign_contract', 'sign_change', 'set_up_payments')) = ("renter_links"."rental_id" is not null)
        and ("renter_links"."purpose"::text = 'sign_change') = ("renter_links"."rental_change_id" is not null)
        and ("renter_links"."purpose"::text in ('sign_contract', 'sign_change')) = ("renter_links"."template_version_id" is not null)
        and ("renter_links"."template_version_id" is null) = ("renter_links"."contract_fingerprint" is null)
        and ("renter_links"."contract_fingerprint" is null or "renter_links"."contract_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

organisation_drivers_removed.name: organisation_drivers_removed
organisation_drivers_removed.value:
("organisation_drivers"."removed_by_user_id" is null or "organisation_drivers"."removed_at" is not null)
        and ("organisation_drivers"."removed_at" is null or "organisation_drivers"."removed_at" >= "organisation_drivers"."added_at")

renters_licence_complete.name: renters_licence_complete
renters_licence_complete.value:
num_nonnulls("renters"."licence_issued_in", "renters"."licence_number", "renters"."licence_class", "renters"."licence_type", "renters"."licence_expires_on") in (0, 5)
        and ("renters"."licence_country" is not null) = coalesce("renters"."licence_issued_in"::text = 'overseas', false)
        and "renters"."licence_number" ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{1,20}$'

renters_organisation_email.name: renters_organisation_email
renters_organisation_email.value: "renters"."retired_at" is not null or "renters"."kind" <> 'organisation' or "renters"."email" is not null

vehicles_one_vin_per_operator.name: vehicles_one_vin_per_operator
vehicles_one_vin_per_operator.where: "vehicles"."vin" is not null and "vehicles"."archived_at" is null

vehicles_status_return_details.name: vehicles_status_return_details
vehicles_status_return_details.value:
("vehicles"."status" in ('in_service', 'off_road')) = ("vehicles"."status_reason" is not null and "vehicles"."status_expected_back" is not null)
        and ("vehicles"."status_reason" is null) = ("vehicles"."status_expected_back" is null)

vehicles_rates.name: vehicles_rates
vehicles_rates.value:
("vehicles"."daily_rate_cents" is null or "vehicles"."daily_rate_cents" > 0)
        and ("vehicles"."long_term_weekly_cents" is null or "vehicles"."long_term_weekly_cents" > 0)

vehicle_registrations_one_per_expiry.name: vehicle_registrations_one_per_expiry
vehicle_registrations_one_per_expiry.where: "vehicle_registrations"."archived_at" is null and "vehicle_registrations"."expires_on" is not null

vehicle_registrations_one_direct_debit.name: vehicle_registrations_one_direct_debit
vehicle_registrations_one_direct_debit.where: "vehicle_registrations"."archived_at" is null and "vehicle_registrations"."expires_on" is null and "vehicle_registrations"."direct_debit_stopped_on" is null

vehicle_registrations_direct_debit.name: vehicle_registrations_direct_debit
vehicle_registrations_direct_debit.value:
("vehicle_registrations"."term_months" = 1) = ("vehicle_registrations"."expires_on" is null)
        and ("vehicle_registrations"."direct_debit_stopped_on" is null or "vehicle_registrations"."term_months" = 1)

rental_rates_amount.name: rental_rates_amount
rental_rates_amount.value:
("rental_rates"."weekly_rate_cents" is null or "rental_rates"."weekly_rate_cents" > 0)
        and ("rental_rates"."daily_rate_cents" is null or "rental_rates"."daily_rate_cents" > 0)

rental_rates_start.name: rental_rates_start
rental_rates_start.value:
("rental_rates"."applies_from" is null) <> ("rental_rates"."applies_from_block" is null)
        and ("rental_rates"."applies_from" is null or "rental_rates"."weekly_rate_cents" is not null)
        and ("rental_rates"."applies_from_block" is null
          or ("rental_rates"."applies_from_block" >= 0 and "rental_rates"."daily_rate_cents" is not null))

rentals_period.name: rentals_period
rentals_period.value:
("rentals"."type" = 'ongoing') = ("rentals"."planned_end" is null)
        and ("rentals"."planned_end" is null or "rentals"."planned_end" > "rentals"."planned_start")

rentals_block_terms.name: rentals_block_terms
rentals_block_terms.value:
("rentals"."rent_model" = 'blocks') = ("rentals"."is_long_term" is not null
          and "rentals"."grace_minutes" is not null and "rentals"."long_term_minimum_days" is not null)
        and ("rentals"."grace_minutes" is null or "rentals"."grace_minutes" between 0 and 240)
        and ("rentals"."long_term_minimum_days" is null or "rentals"."long_term_minimum_days" between 1 and 90)
        and ("rentals"."booked_blocks" is null or "rentals"."booked_blocks" > 0)
        and ("rentals"."rent_model" = 'weekday' or "rentals"."is_long_term" or "rentals"."booked_blocks" is not null)
        and ("rentals"."daily_rate_waived_reason" is null
          or ("rentals"."is_long_term" and length(trim("rentals"."daily_rate_waived_reason")) > 0))

rentals_debits_paused.name: rentals_debits_paused
rentals_debits_paused.value:
("rentals"."debits_paused_at" is null) = ("rentals"."debits_paused_reason" is null)
        and ("rentals"."debits_paused_reason" is null or length(trim("rentals"."debits_paused_reason")) > 0)

rentals_cancelled.name: rentals_cancelled
rentals_cancelled.value:
("rentals"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("rentals"."cancelled_at" is not null)
        and ("rentals"."cancelled_at" is null) = ("rentals"."cancellation_reason" is null)

rentals_driver_when_out.name: rentals_driver_when_out
rentals_driver_when_out.value: "rentals"."status" not in ('active', 'returned', 'closed') or "rentals"."driver_id" is not null

rentals_returned.name: rentals_returned
rentals_returned.value:
("rentals"."status" in ('returned', 'closed')) = ("rentals"."returned_at" is not null)
        and ("rentals"."returned_at" is null or "rentals"."returned_at" >= "rentals"."handed_over_at")

bond_movements_stripe_object_kind.name: bond_movements_stripe_object_kind
bond_movements_stripe_object_kind.value:
("bond_movements"."stripe_object_id" is null) = ("bond_movements"."stripe_object_kind" is null)
        and ("bond_movements"."stripe_object_kind" is null or "bond_movements"."stripe_object_kind" in ('refund', 'dispute'))

bond_movements_note.name: bond_movements_note
bond_movements_note.value: "bond_movements"."kind" not in ('deducted', 'reversal') or "bond_movements"."note" is not null

inspections_completed.name: inspections_completed
inspections_completed.value:
("inspections"."status" = 'completed') = ("inspections"."completed_at" is not null)
        and ("inspections"."status" <> 'completed' or ("inspections"."odometer_km" is not null
          and "inspections"."fuel_level" is not null and "inspections"."keys_count" is not null
          and "inspections"."acceptance_text" is not null))

inspections_signature.name: inspections_signature
inspections_signature.value:
("inspections"."signature_method" is null or "inspections"."signature_method" in ('drawn', 'typed'))
        and ("inspections"."signature_method" = 'typed') = ("inspections"."typed_name" is not null)

damage_records_position.name: damage_records_position
damage_records_position.value:
("damage_records"."x" is null) = ("damage_records"."y" is null)
        and ("damage_records"."x" is null or ("damage_records"."x" between 0 and 1000
          and "damage_records"."y" between 0 and 1000))

damage_records_from_return.name: damage_records_from_return
damage_records_from_return.value: ("damage_records"."damage_mark_id" is null) or ("damage_records"."return_inspection_id" is not null)

insurance_claims_dates.name: insurance_claims_dates
insurance_claims_dates.value: "insurance_claims"."settled_on" is null or "insurance_claims"."lodged_on" is null or "insurance_claims"."settled_on" >= "insurance_claims"."lodged_on"

rental_changes_end_values.name: rental_changes_end_values
rental_changes_end_values.value:
("rental_changes"."kind" = 'weekly_rate') = ("rental_changes"."type_after" is null)
        and ("rental_changes"."kind" <> 'end_date' or ("rental_changes"."end_after" is not null and "rental_changes"."type_after" = 'fixed_term'))
        and ("rental_changes"."kind" <> 'make_ongoing' or ("rental_changes"."end_after" is null and "rental_changes"."type_after" = 'ongoing'))

rental_changes_rate_values.name: rental_changes_rate_values
rental_changes_rate_values.value:
("rental_changes"."kind" = 'weekly_rate') = ("rental_changes"."rate_after_cents" is not null)
        and ("rental_changes"."rate_after_cents" is null or ("rental_changes"."rate_after_cents" > 0
          and "rental_changes"."rate_before_cents" > 0
          and ("rental_changes"."applies_from" is null) <> ("rental_changes"."applies_from_block" is null)))
        and ("rental_changes"."applies_from_block" is null or "rental_changes"."applies_from_block" > 0)

rental_changes_status_times.name: rental_changes_status_times
rental_changes_status_times.value:
("rental_changes"."status" = 'applied') = ("rental_changes"."applied_at" is not null)
        and ("rental_changes"."status" = 'withdrawn') = ("rental_changes"."withdrawn_at" is not null)
        and ("rental_changes"."kind" <> 'weekly_rate' or "rental_changes"."status" <> 'applied' or "rental_changes"."document_id" is not null)

car_swaps_completed.name: car_swaps_completed
car_swaps_completed.value:
("car_swaps"."status" = 'completed') = ("car_swaps"."swapped_at" is not null)
        and ("car_swaps"."status" <> 'completed' or ("car_swaps"."document_id" is not null
          and "car_swaps"."from_vehicle_status_after" in ('available', 'in_service', 'off_road')))

charge_types_named.name: charge_types_named
charge_types_named.value: ("charge_types"."built_in" is null) = ("charge_types"."name" is not null and length(trim("charge_types"."name")) > 0)

ledger_lines_one_block_rent_per_period.name: ledger_lines_one_block_rent_per_period
ledger_lines_one_block_rent_per_period.where: "ledger_lines"."kind" = 'charge' and not "ledger_lines"."is_correction" and "ledger_lines"."period_starts_at" is not null

ledger_lines_block_period.name: ledger_lines_block_period
ledger_lines_block_period.value:
("ledger_lines"."period_starts_at" is null) = ("ledger_lines"."period_ends_at" is null)
        and ("ledger_lines"."period_starts_at" is null or ("ledger_lines"."kind" in ('charge', 'credit')
          and "ledger_lines"."period_start" is null and "ledger_lines"."period_ends_at" > "ledger_lines"."period_starts_at"))
        and (not "ledger_lines"."is_correction" or "ledger_lines"."period_starts_at" is not null)

ledger_lines_period.name: ledger_lines_period
ledger_lines_period.value:
("ledger_lines"."period_start" is null) = ("ledger_lines"."period_end" is null)
        and ("ledger_lines"."period_start" is null or ("ledger_lines"."kind" in ('charge', 'credit')
          and "ledger_lines"."period_end" > "ledger_lines"."period_start"))

payment_mandates_ended.name: payment_mandates_ended
payment_mandates_ended.value:
("payment_mandates"."status" = 'inactive') = ("payment_mandates"."end_reason" is not null)
        and ("payment_mandates"."end_reason" is null) = ("payment_mandates"."ended_at" is null)

payments_id_shapes.name: payments_id_shapes
payments_id_shapes.value:
("payments"."stripe_checkout_session_id" is null or "payments"."stripe_checkout_session_id" ~ '^cs_[A-Za-z0-9_]+$')
        and ("payments"."stripe_payment_intent_id" is null or "payments"."stripe_payment_intent_id" ~ '^pi_[A-Za-z0-9]+$')

payments_purpose_details.name: payments_purpose_details
payments_purpose_details.value:
("payments"."purpose"::text = 'bond') = ("payments"."stripe_checkout_session_id" is not null)
        and ("payments"."purpose"::text = 'bond') = ("payments"."mandate_id" is null)
        and ("payments"."purpose"::text = 'bond') = ("payments"."requested_at" is null)
        and ("payments"."purpose"::text = 'scheduled_debit') = ("payments"."period_starts_at" is not null)
        and ("payments"."purpose"::text = 'bond' or "payments"."method" = 'becs_debit')

payments_intent_known.name: payments_intent_known
payments_intent_known.value:
"payments"."stripe_payment_intent_id" is not null
        or ("payments"."purpose"::text <> 'bond' and "payments"."status" in ('pending', 'failed'))

stripe_checkouts_amount.name: stripe_checkouts_amount
stripe_checkouts_amount.value:
("stripe_checkouts"."purpose" = 'bond') = ("stripe_checkouts"."amount_cents" is not null)
        and ("stripe_checkouts"."amount_cents" is null or "stripe_checkouts"."amount_cents" > 0)

debit_plans_weeks.name: debit_plans_weeks
debit_plans_weeks.value:
("debit_plans"."plan" = 'split') = ("debit_plans"."weeks" is not null)
        and ("debit_plans"."weeks" is null or "debit_plans"."weeks" between 2 and 12)

payment_ledger_lines_object.name: payment_ledger_lines_object
payment_ledger_lines_object.value:
("payment_ledger_lines"."reason" = 'settled') = ("payment_ledger_lines"."stripe_object_id" is null)
        and ("payment_ledger_lines"."stripe_object_id" is null or "payment_ledger_lines"."stripe_object_id" ~ '^[a-z]+_[A-Za-z0-9]+$')
